facts.text: Waldorf Astoria Ras Al Khaimah is home to seven restaurants, lounges and bars.
facts.excerpt: Waldorf Astoria Ras Al Khaimah is home to seven restaurants, lounges, and bars

facts.text: Lexington Grill & Bar is the signature restaurant, a New York steakhouse-style restaurant serving steaks, seafood and plant-based dishes.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in a remarkable selection of mouthwatering steaks, delectable seafood, and exquisite plant-based dishes at Lexington Grill & Bar. Our extraordinary New York steakhouse-style restaurant

facts.text: Lexington Grill & Bar has a wine cellar.
facts.excerpt: boasts an impressive wine cellar and opulent ambiance

facts.text: At Lexington Grill & Bar guests can see the dry-age selection, hear a live band, and choose their own knife, salt and condiments.
facts.excerpt: witness our extensive dry-age selection, accompanied by the captivating tunes of a live band. Personalize your meal by selecting your knife, salt, and condiments.

facts.text: Qasr Al Bahar serves breakfast and dinner, with floor-to-ceiling windows and an outdoor terrace.
facts.excerpt: Welcome to Qasr Al Bahar – the ideal spot to kick off your day with stunning views from floor-to-ceiling windows and a spacious outdoor terrace.

facts.text: Qasr Al Bahar has a designated children's area with interactive features.
facts.excerpt: Our restaurant even offers a designated children’s area with fun interactive features.

facts.text: Azure, beside the resort's main pool, serves Mediterranean food inspired by the coastlines of Italy, Greece, Turkey and beyond.
facts.excerpt: Set beside the resort’s main pool, Azure brings together the vibrant flavours of the Mediterranean, inspired by the coastlines of Italy, Greece, Turkey, and beyond.

facts.text: Camelia Lounge sits in the grand lobby overlooking the Arabian Gulf and is known for its afternoon tea.
facts.excerpt: Located in the heart of the resort’s grand lobby, Camelia Lounge is a refined gathering place overlooking the Arabian Gulf. Renowned for its signature afternoon tea

facts.text: Sunset Beach Lounge is a beachfront lounge reserved for adults.
Sunset Beach Lounge is by the infinity pool and the beach.
facts.excerpt: it is the ideal setting for leisurely afternoons by the infinity pool and the beach.

facts.text: Palm Shore Pool Bar is beside the resort's family pool.
facts.excerpt: Located beside the resort’s family pool, Palm Shore Pool Bar

facts.text: The 18-hole Peter Harradine-designed championship course at Al Hamra Golf Club is adjacent to the resort.
facts.excerpt: 18-hole Peter Harradine-designed championship golf course at the Al Hamra Golf Club, located adjacent to the resort

facts.text: On the Al Hamra course, four interconnected open water lagoons merge with the water of the Arabian Gulf.
facts.excerpt: Four interconnected open water lagoons merge seamlessly with the water of the Arabian Gulf.

facts.text: Al Hamra Golf Club uses floodlights so golfers can play a composite 9-hole course at night.
facts.excerpt: Al Hamra Golf Club utilizes the latest zero-pollution floodlights to offer golfers the ability to play into the night. Using a combination of the front nine and back nine championship courses, a composite 9-hole course is created

facts.text: Group and individual golf lessons are offered at Al Hamra Golf Club with PGA professional Damien Scott.
facts.excerpt: led by our PGA professional, Damien Scott. We offer both group and individual lessons

facts.text: Al Hamra Golf Club facilities include indoor padel tennis courts.
Executive Chef Michael Kreiling leads the hotel's kitchens.
facts.excerpt: Executive Chef Michael Kreiling brings a wealth of culinary expertise to Waldorf Astoria Ras Al Khaimah

facts.text: The hotel has eight dining outlets.
facts.excerpt: the hotel’s eight distinctive dining outlets

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler lists the hotel under its Readers' Choice Awards 2017.
